title: Graph inference farm
description: A pool of worker processes that each infer whole projects into a private staging directory of their own; the parent adopts the finished leaves under its writer custody and every message is plain data. A retiring worker continues to own its slot until its process exits. Replacement may start only after that exit, and pool close joins all retiring generations before returning. A refused or declined pool returns its capacity only after its worker processes settle, while still releasing before the overall graph closes.

en.waiting: graph: asking the host for up to {workers} worker processes for {projects} projects; projects are inferred in this process meanwhile
en.starting: graph: inferring projects with {workers} worker processes ({megabytes} MB each)
en.own: graph: {workers} worker process inside the capacity grant of this process ({megabytes} MB) infers projects now, the host is asked for more
en.serial: graph: inferring {projects} projects in this process ({reason})
en.refused: graph: worker processes were not used because they differ from this process ({reason}); projects are inferred in this process
en.lost: graph: a worker process was lost ({reason}); its project is inferred again
en.degraded: graph: no more worker processes ({reason}); the remaining projects are inferred in this process
en.failed: graph: a worker could not infer project {project} ({reason}); it is inferred in this process
en.declined: graph: the graph cache declined the leaves of project {project}; it is inferred in this process

de.serial: Graph: {projects} Projekte werden in diesem Prozess abgeleitet ({reason})
de.refused: Graph: Worker-Prozesse wurden nicht verwendet, weil sie von diesem Prozess abweichen ({reason}); Projekte werden in diesem Prozess abgeleitet
de.lost: Graph: ein Worker-Prozess ging verloren ({reason}); sein Projekt wird erneut abgeleitet
de.degraded: Graph: keine Worker-Prozesse mehr ({reason}); die übrigen Projekte werden in diesem Prozess abgeleitet

de.declined: Graph: der Graph-Cache hat die Blätter von Projekt {project} abgelehnt; es wird in diesem Prozess abgeleitet
